skill.name: fulfill-git-escrow
skill.description: Guides an AI coding agent through git escrow bounty validation, solution preparation, git commit creation, fulfillment submission, and collection follow-up using the git-escrows CLI.
skill.summary: Guide git escrow bounty validation, solution submission, and collection follow-up.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: The skill legitimately centers on shell and git-escrows CLI usage. Several markdown backtick hits are false positives, but command execution, escrow network operations, and secret handling are confirmed. The largest risks are PRIVATE_KEY-backed .env use, CLI private-key setup, and blockchain escrow actions without explicit confirmation. No prompt injection attempt was found in SKILL.md.

remediation.suggestion: Do not ask the model to inspect, receive, or echo private keys. Require user-managed wallet or CLI configuration outside the conversation.
Require explicit user confirmation before running fulfill or collect commands that may sign or submit blockchain transactions.
Replace git add -A with reviewed file-specific staging or require a staged diff review before committing.
Clone test repositories into fresh unique directories and avoid running project scripts unless the user approves.
Prefer a pinned git-escrows installation over npx or bunx fallback execution from the network.

content.value_statement: Git escrow bounties require careful test review, git handling, and blockchain CLI submission. This skill guides validation, solution preparation, fulfillment submission, and follow-up status checks.
actual_capabilities: Checks whether the git-escrows CLI is available.
Validates escrow status and key escrow details from the CLI output.
Clones the escrow test repository at the specified commit.
Guides solution file creation based on test expectations.
Commits a new solution or submits an existing solution commit.
Reports fulfillment identifiers and follow-up collection steps.
limitations: Requires git, git-escrows, network access, and user-managed wallet configuration.
Does not guarantee that the oracle will accept the submitted solution.
Can affect the current git workspace if changes are not reviewed.
Requires careful handling of private keys and environment files.

use_cases.title: Solve a new escrow challenge
use_cases.description: Implement code from test expectations and submit the resulting commit.

use_cases.title: Submit an existing solution
use_cases.description: Collect required repository and commit details, then submit them to an escrow.

use_cases.title: Track fulfillment next steps
use_cases.description: Report fulfillment identifiers and prepare status or collection follow-up.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect an escrow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner validation before any code changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fulfill-git-escrow to inspect escrow UID <uid>. Summarize its status, test repository, reward, oracle, and missing information before running any submission step.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a solution workspace
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate setup for a new challenge.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fulfill-git-escrow in write mode for escrow UID <uid>. Review the test repository, identify expected files, and propose a solution plan before editing files.

prompt_templates.title: Submit an existing solution
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate submission using a known repository and commit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fulfill-git-escrow with escrow UID <uid>, solution repository <repo>, and solution commit <commit>. Confirm the details with me before submitting.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a failed fulfillment
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced troubleshooting after a command or oracle failure.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use fulfill-git-escrow to analyze this failed fulfillment for escrow UID <uid>. Check status, network assumptions, key registration, repository accessibility, and next remediation steps.

output_examples.input: Inspect an open escrow before I start solving it.
output: A short escrow summary with status, reward, oracle, test source, and required next inputs.
A clear warning if wallet configuration or network access is missing.
A proposed next step before any transaction is submitted.

output_examples.input: Submit my existing solution repository and commit.
output: A confirmation summary for the escrow UID, repository, and commit.
A fulfillment result that highlights the fulfillment UID when submission succeeds.
Follow-up guidance for checking status and collecting after approval.

output_examples.input: Help me fix a failed escrow fulfillment.
output: A diagnosis of likely causes such as closed escrow, wrong network, inaccessible repository, or unregistered key.
A prioritized list of checks to run before retrying.
A concise explanation of what changed and what still needs user confirmation.

best_practices: Confirm escrow UID, network, repository URL, and commit hash before submission.
Keep private keys outside chat and review environment file handling manually.
Review git status and staged changes before committing or submitting a solution.
anti_patterns: Submitting fulfill or collect actions without explicit user approval.
Using broad git staging without checking which files will be committed.
Trusting unknown test repositories or generated commands without review.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an agent through validating a git escrow bounty, preparing a solution, submitting a commit, and reporting follow-up steps.

faq.question: Does it require a wallet private key?
faq.answer: The underlying git-escrows workflow expects user-managed private key configuration. Do not paste private keys into chat.

faq.question: Can it submit an existing solution?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the escrow UID, solution repository, and solution commit so the agent can prepare the submission flow.

faq.question: Can it write a new solution?
faq.answer: Yes. It can inspect the test repository, create expected files, commit changes, and prepare a fulfillment submission.

faq.question: Does it guarantee reward collection?
faq.answer: No. The escrow oracle must accept the fulfillment before collection is possible.

faq.question: What should I review before using it?
faq.answer: Review the escrow details, staged files, repository URL, commit hash, network, and any transaction prompt before proceeding.
